If you've just bought [b]Breeding Village[/b] during our launch week sale then we invite you to pick up any other of our authentic Japanese-style adult visual novels for 20% off!

If you missed the launch week sale and you already own one of our other VNs then you can complete a bundle set and get [b]Breeding Village[/b] for the same launch week 20% discount.

And if you don't any of our titles yet then this is your chance to get two exciting visual novels for 20% off each.  Double the savings, double the enjoyment!

The special Golden Week bundles will end on May 6.
